text:
Maya: Starting staged rollout for v3.4.2 -> 10% global (quiet window 03:30-04:30 UTC). Noticed EU p95 drift since 03:12 UTC. Requesting ops triage and quick vote: pin/hold EU or continue?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Automated update: rollout v3.4.2 started at 03:15 UTC. Targets: 120 hosts, canaries deployed to 12 hosts. Telemetry stream live.

Kevin: Link to Grafana: https://grafana.company.net/d/rollouts/summary?from=03:00&to=03:30 - EU p95 +120ms vs baseline, tail increased, error rate ~unchanged (~0.15%). :thinking_face:

Sam: I pulled canary logs. Seeing KV cache miss bursts and intermittent higher CPU on canary shards in eu-west. Quick snippet: `kv_cache_miss=13%` vs baseline `~2%`. Also a few `503` spikes aligned with miss bursts.

Olivia: If miss bursts are localized to canaries, we should pin eu region back to v3.4.1 while infra investigates. We can keep global 10% for non-EU. Proposed command: `redwoodctl pin --region eu-west --version 3.4.1 --reason "kv_cache_miss_regression"`

Devex_Jordan: Release notes have been updated with the v3.4.2 changes and a note for potential EU rollback. If we pin, I’ll add a short rollback blurb to the emailed changelog and docs.

Priya: Ops recommendation: soft-hold for EU. Execute pin on eu-west, stop further traffic shifts there, keep rollout progressing elsewhere at current 10%. Then run a focused canary replay against eu infra for 15m to capture traces. Rollback command (if needed): `rolloutctl rollback --region eu-west --target-version 3.4.1 --force`

Maya: Quick vote: react with :thumbsup: to approve pin EU / :thumbsdown: to abort pin and continue global. Also say "go-rest" or "hold-eu" if you prefer text. Need consensus in 3m.

Kevin: hold-eu :thumbsup:

Sam: hold-eu — saw the same KV miss pattern locally.

Olivia: +1 hold-eu. Will hold any client-side schema flips for EU.

Devex_Jordan: +1 hold-eu. I’ll update release notes and add a customer-facing advisory if we keep EU pinned >30m.

Priya: Performing pin now. Running: `redwoodctl pin --region eu-west --version 3.4.1 --reason kv_cache_miss_regression`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Action executed at 03:25 UTC: region=eu-west pinned to 3.4.1. Further traffic shifts to eu-west halted. Canary instances in eu-west restored to 3.4.1 (12/12). Monitoring: increased instrumentation on kv cache.

Maya: Thanks team. Plan: investigate KV cache config and kernel path on those canaries, replay synthetic trace for 15m, reconvene in 20m with findings. Keeping rollout at 10% global excluding EU.

Sam: Copy. I’ll start the replay and post logs.

Kevin: I’ll watch Grafana and paging alerts.

Olivia: I’ll prep the quick advisory draft in #customer-comm.

Maya: Closing thread for now — actioned: EU pinned, global 10% continues (non-EU). Will re-open if new signal. :white_check_mark:
